intent: Implement Evolution Expert 2.1.0 as the Agent-neutral conversational entry for Runtime 6.1.0 production-reference intake, project Pipeline capability disposition, immutable Lifecycle successor review, comparable experiment observation, exact human decisions, policy-bounded activation, monitoring, and rollback over MCP.
objective: Let ordinary users safely manage and evolve third-party project Pipeline Lifecycles from Codex, Claude Code, designated-human WorkBuddy, generic MCP, independent Hosts, and headless administration without knowing raw schemas or commands and without giving Expert state, execution, Harness, or authority ownership.

evidence.authority: Roadmap application and Target drafting authority only.
Bounded Roadmap validation repair and Target drafting authority only.
Immutable published v6 Runtime/Expert completion baseline.
Read-only DataRig Suite 2.1.11 capability inventory used for interaction design and acceptance only.

include: Extend one Agent-neutral Expert Core with progressive-disclosure journeys for production-reference discovery, snapshot validation, capability disposition, resource preview, and generic-gap escalation.

Guide observation review, immutable successor proposal, semantic and authority diff, compatibility and impact review, Champion/Challenger comparison, bad-case closure, and evidence interpretation from canonical Runtime MCP facts.
Present policy-bounded safe activation separately from semantic or authority decisions and never infer approval from readiness, conversational agreement, or successful validation.
Guide future-run activation, health monitoring, deterministic rollback, restart/resume, audit, and finite recovery from Runtime-owned durable state rather than chat history.
Generate deterministic Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, and generic MCP Host Integration Bundles from one Core; WorkBuddy execution remains designated-human-only.
Render DataRig Suite 2.1.11 only as read-only source provenance and explain datarig-production-delivery@1.0.0 declarative dispositions without invoking, mutating, or depending on the Suite.
Preserve Harness-guided Goal Target Loop guidance over a real published immutable HarnessBundle and qualified external Agent Runtime execution.
Provide install, doctor, health, version, compatibility, upgrade, rollback, removal, tutorial, help, and exact documentation routing for Expert 2.1.0 and Runtime 6.1.0.
Provide criterion-specific validators, cross-Host semantic conformance, exact Candidate-pair binding, impact closure, and NO_REGRESSION.
exclude: No Expert-owned project, Lifecycle, proposal, experiment, policy, activation, monitoring, rollback, evidence, credential, acceptance, publication, or release truth.
No direct source execution, embedded coding Agent, raw credential capture, Runtime mutation outside MCP, or Host-specific product semantics.
No DataRig or EvoPilot Suite invocation, mutation, synchronization, Cutover, hidden fallback, or project-specific Core branch.
No Harness selection invention, authoring, mutation, approval, Catalog change, publication, or obligation weakening.
No production/database authority, WorkBuddy operation by Codex, Candidate, E2E, publication, or Release under this draft.

acceptance.criterion: Expert discovers exact Runtime, protocol, capability, Host, documentation, project, Lifecycle, Harness, and production-reference facts before guiding controlled evolution.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Discovery transcript and negative stale, incompatible, unavailable, or incomplete Runtime fact tests.

acceptance.criterion: Expert guides DataRig Suite 2.1.11 read-only snapshot validation and renders every capability disposition, provenance binding, unmapped item, and generic-gap outcome without Suite invocation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Exact 20-item guided review transcript, digest checks, Suite Gate facts, zero invocation, and no silent exclusion.

acceptance.criterion: Expert guides observation, classification, immutable successor preview, semantic diff, compatibility, impact, migration, experiment, monitoring, rollback, and provenance from Runtime-owned facts.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: End-to-end dialogue transcript with exact object and digest correspondence to Runtime MCP results.

acceptance.criterion: Expert renders comparable Champion/Challenger evidence, explains non-comparable stratification and bad-case closure, and never turns a recommendation into authority.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Comparable and mismatched experiment transcripts plus decision separation evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Expert distinguishes policy-preauthorized safe activation from semantic or authority gates and asks only the unresolved exact decision with its bound digest and consequences.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Decision-frame matrix, progressive-disclosure transcripts, and negative inferred-approval tests.

acceptance.criterion: Expert guides activation for future runs, monitoring, deterministic rollback, audit, restart/resume, and finite recovery solely from Runtime-owned state.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-restart and cross-Host transcripts proving no chat-history dependency or active-run rebinding.

acceptance.criterion: Expert explains and guides an explicit generic Runtime or Expert Target proposal when a project Pipeline need lacks a safe public primitive, then stops without mutation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Unknown-gap journey with exact proposal digest, boundary explanation, finite next action, and zero source change.

acceptance.criterion: Codex, Claude Code, designated-human WorkBuddy, generic MCP, independent Host, and headless administration preserve one Core semantics and one Runtime truth across controlled evolution.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Generated bundle digests, semantic conformance, cross-Host transfer, designated-human declaration, and headless recovery evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Expert is stateless and non-authoritative and cannot own, fabricate, mutate, approve, activate, publish, or release any Runtime, project, Suite, Harness, or credential state.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Architecture, protocol, adversarial dialogue, persistence scan, and authority-negative tests.

acceptance.criterion: One Agent-neutral Core generates all Host bundles without Host-specific project semantics, while future Hosts qualify through the public integration contract without Core changes.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Core and adapter digests, generated-output determinism, independent Host conformance, and zero Core diff.

acceptance.criterion: Expert version, Candidate, acceptance, release, upgrade, and rollback remain independent from Runtime and project resource versions through explicit compatibility negotiation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Version matrix, compatible independent upgrade/rollback, incompatible-version stop, and public package metadata tests.

acceptance.criterion: Expert 2.1.0 acceptance closes only on exact installed Expert 2.1.0 and Runtime 6.1.0 Candidates with all current criteria, the immutable v6 253-item baseline, cross acceptance, impact closure, and NO_REGRESSION passing.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Independent completion recomputation with exact Candidate/Core bindings and zero failed, pending, stale, generic, silent-exclusion, or unmapped items.

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: Every one of the immutable published v6 completion contract's 253 criteria remains applicable and must pass against the Runtime 6.1.0 and Expert 2.1.0 Candidate pair without exclusions.
inheritedAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Fresh successor validation of the full v6 completion contract with criterion-level evidence.

regressionImpact.area: Expert 2.1.0 extends the ordinary-human control plane entry and can affect every published v6 Expert, MCP, Host, authority, Harness-guidance, recovery, documentation, and versioning guarantee.
regressionImpact.reason: The immutable completion-contract aggregate preserves the exact criterion-level baseline and cross-product obligations.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A new Codex user discovers Runtime 6.1.0, imports the DataRig 2.1.11 production reference read-only, and reviews all capability dispositions without raw schemas or Suite invocation.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Installed-Candidate transcript, Core and Runtime digests, inventory coverage, and legacySuiteInvocationCount=0.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Expert guides an observation into an immutable successor, complete semantic diff, and comparable Champion/Challenger plan.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Dialogue-to-MCP object correspondence and unchanged active revision evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Expert explains a safe preauthorized activation and separately stops a semantic or authority change at one exact human decision.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Safe predicate rendering, decision-frame equality, no inferred approval, and finite next action.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A designated human performs the frozen WorkBuddy controlled-evolution journey without Codex operation or observation.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Exact Candidate-bound designated-human declaration for the declared WorkBuddy range.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A controlled evolution journey starts in Codex, is inspected in Claude Code, and resumes through an independent Host from Runtime truth rather than chat history.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Cross-Host semantic equality, object digests, restart/resume, and Core binding evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Expert guides a real HarnessBundle-bound Goal Target Loop after Lifecycle evolution and never weakens or mutates Harness obligations.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Harness asset chain, combined plan, pendingExecution, receipt, Loop, and monotonic obligation evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Expert identifies a missing generic primitive, prepares an exact Target proposal, and stops without project-specific Core or Runtime mutation.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Gap facts, proposal digest, boundary explanation, stop reason, and zero source change.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Expert unavailable: headless diagnostics preserve recovery and audit without exposing a silent direct ordinary-human mutation path.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Degraded-mode recovery, access-boundary, and negative hidden-fallback evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Expert upgrades and rolls back independently while remaining compatible with the exact Runtime protocol range and project resource versions.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Bundle install, upgrade, rollback, compatibility, and version-skew evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Adversarial dialogue cannot infer authority, expose raw secrets, invoke a Suite, mutate a Harness, aggregate non-comparable evidence, or publish any result.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Security and authority corpus with exact stop reasons and no prohibited effects.
